'''Blake''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] who was at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and later became a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Blake was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was present at the Alliance's secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Gamer " /> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered Echo Base after one of their [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] landed on Hoth, they launched a [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|full-scale assault]] against the Rebels. The Rebels decided to flee,<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> and Blake was present in Echo Base's south [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] when [[Quantum Storm/Legends|the first]] of the Alliance's [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|evacuation transports]] safely escaped the [[Hoth system/Legends|system]]. Though the Alliance was able to successfully evacuate Echo Base, they suffered many casualties and the battle was viewed as a significant victory for the Empire. Nevertheless, Blake believed that the battle was the Alliance's finest hour and that it proved that the spirit of the Rebel Alliance could never truly be broken by a military power.<ref name="Gamer " />

The Alliance went on to win a major victory against the Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and soon after reformed itself into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Blake served the New Republic as a [[General/Legends|general]] and used the experiences at Hoth to train [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] in combat. Blake put the cadets through a three-part simulation of the Battle of Hoth, splitting them up into two teams that each took on the role of either the Alliance's General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] or the Empire's General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], and pitting them against each other to gain control of Echo Base. Blake hoped that the simulation would give the cadets a better understanding of Alliance's victory at Hoth, and that they would pass on the lessons they learned.<ref name="Gamer " />
